input_units.radial_fraction: dimensionless native coordinate / maximum sampled coordinate

timing_contract: Boundary pressure, mass flux, supplied thermodynamic quality, density properties and measurement coordinate only; no measured target-derived velocity, dynamic pressure, phase label or fitted per-run offset.
calibration: Saturation densities are fixed IAPWS-derived inputs from absolute pressure, not learned from void-fraction targets. Global profile coefficients use development runs only.

baseline_flex.equation: Gaussian-kernel ridge with frozen training-only scales/centers/coefficients; clip output to [0,1], multiply E0 for stiffness.

baseline_nested_flex.equation: Gaussian-kernel ridge with frozen training-only scales/centers/coefficients; clip output to [0,1], multiply E0 for stiffness.

uncertainty_policy.reason: Show every complete reserved group. Within-system and temporal dependence, few condition blocks or calibrated sites limit population-level claims; no row-bootstrap confidence interval is claimed.

scope_limits: Three complete radial profiles at one KTH facility. Conditional on supplied boundary quality and normalized observed measurement coordinates; no universal closure, flow-regime discovery or physical wall-coordinate claim.

exposure.historical_record: All reference confirmation targets are exposed. This is a retrospective diagnostic evaluation, not fresh independent confirmation.

historical_metric_corrections: F1 uses2TP/(2TP+FP+FN); zero on nonempty total failure. Historical reports unchanged.
